CFML Language Reference: Functions

AuthenticatedUser

Returns the user name of the person who logged in with CFAUTHENTICATE (or is being impersonated with CFIMPERSONATE) during the current request.

Category

Authentication functions

Syntax

AuthenticatedUser()

Returns

The user name, or an empty string if nobody is authenticated.

Usage

Call IsAuthenticated first: it also reads the CFAUTHORIZATION cookie left by an earlier request, after which AuthenticatedUser knows the name. With Advanced Security not set up the result is always empty.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET LoggedIn = IsAuthenticated()>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>IsAuthenticated()</TD><TD>#LoggedIn#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>AuthenticatedUser()</TD><TD>"#AuthenticatedUser()#"</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P>Hello, #IIf(Len(AuthenticatedUser()), "AuthenticatedUser()", DE("guest"))#!
</CFOUTPUT>

See also
